## Motivation

A context-parallel KV layout that keeps each rank's KV sharded and padded (`--cp-kv-layout` with a strategy that sets `cp_kv_sharded`) sizes and indexes KV per rank. The unified memory pool's placement and PD transfers do not model that layout, so the combination could only fail later, at allocation or transfer time.

## Modifications

- `arg_groups/parallel_hook.py::handle_context_parallelism`: right after the CP strategy is bound, a sharded-padded strategy together with `--enable-unified-memory` is refused with a clear error. Static pools keep the sharded-padded accounting.
- `test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py`: with a sharded-padded strategy bound, unified memory is refused and the static pool is accepted.

**Behavior change:** `--enable-unified-memory` with a sharded-padded `--cp-kv-layout` now fails at startup instead of later.

## Accuracy Tests

Startup-only check; no model output changes. Covered by the unit test above. Stack-level serving validation is described in the top PR of the stack.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable (startup argument validation).

- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -193,14 +193,20 @@ def handle_context_parallelism(server_args: Any):
             "attn_cp_size != moe_dp_size is only supported when moe_dp_size == 1"
         )
 
-    from sglang.srt.layers.cp.base import init_cp_strategy
+    from sglang.srt.layers.cp.base import init_cp_strategy, is_cp_sharded_padded
 
     init_cp_strategy(
         enable_prefill_cp=bool(cfg.enable_prefill_cp),
         cp_size=cfg.attn_cp_size,
         cp_strategy=cfg.cp_strategy,
         cp_kv_layout=cfg.cp_kv_layout,
     )
+    if cfg.enable_unified_memory and is_cp_sharded_padded():
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"--cp-kv-layout {cfg.cp_kv_layout} keeps each rank's KV sharded "
+            "and padded, which --enable-unified-memory does not support; "
+            "drop one of them."
+        )
 
 
 def handle_shared_experts_tp(server_args: Any):

@@ -2172,6 +2172,23 @@ def test_deepseek_v32_prefill_cp_rejects_zigzag(self):
         with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "DeepSeek V3.2.*interleave"):
             handle_context_parallelism(server_args)
 
+    def test_sharded_padded_cp_kv_layout_refuses_unified_memory(self):
+        for unified in (False, True):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(unified=unified),
+                patch(
+                    "sglang.srt.layers.cp.base.is_cp_sharded_padded", return_value=True
+                ),
+            ):
+                server_args = self._new_cp_args(enable_unified_memory=unified)
+                if unified:
+                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+                        ValueError, "--enable-unified-memory does not support"
+                    ):
+                        handle_context_parallelism(server_args)
+                else:
+                    handle_context_parallelism(server_args)
+
     def test_generic_v1_cp_options_are_not_public_cli(self):
         removed_options = (
             ("--enable-prefill-context-parallel", []),

                     moe_dp_size=1,
                     cp_strategy=None,
                     cp_kv_layout=None,

                     tp_size=4,
                     dp_size=1,
                     attn_dp_size=1,
